statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are concerning for underlying arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
CPT code 93247 is a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study
The service is indicated to evaluate for potential atrial fibrillation or other dysrhythmias
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
